SummaryOfFindings: The Evidence Manager integration is Partially Mocked. 1. Read Path: The dashboard reads context/04_parameter_registry.csv for display purposes in the 'Evidence Manager' tab (Line 1045). However, the simulation itself (p_base and p_game) does NOT load data from this CSV. Instead, it relies on hardcoded defaults in ParamsJax and a hardcoded list of 10 parameters managed via Streamlit sliders and st.session_state. 2. Write/Promote Path: When a user 'promotes' evidence in Tab 6 (Line 1084), it updates st.session_state[selected_param]. This change only affects the simulation if the parameter is one of the 10 'Strategic Levers' explicitly passed to the Params constructor in the main function (Lines 835-846). For any other parameter in the registry, the 'Promote' action has no effect on the model output. 3. Mock Identification: The list of parameters in initialize_slider_state (Line 63) is hardcoded. The p_game constructor (Line 835) hardcodes the mapping from session state to model parameters. The 'Active Parameter Registry' is a static view of the CSV and is not 'Live' in the sense of being the source of truth for the running model.
